content.name: Callum Brierley
content.title: Junior Business Analyst
content.summary: Junior business analyst who joined through the Level 4 Business Analyst apprenticeship after six months in insurance customer operations. Completed the apprenticeship with a Distinction and now work on process and requirements for a digital services agency's public-sector clients. Bring a front-line view of how processes actually work, plus solid process mapping and user story skills.

experience.title: Junior Business Analyst (Apprentice until August 2025)
bullets: Mapped the current blue-badge renewal process for a council client with eight staff interviews, finding three duplicate data entry points.
Wrote 70 user stories with acceptance criteria for an online renewal form; first-month online uptake reached 46% of renewals.
Ran usability sessions with five residents alongside the UX designer and fed changes back into the backlog.
Kept the RAID log and weekly status notes for a team of nine during the build.

experience.title: Customer Operations Assistant
bullets: Handled around 60 policy change requests a day by phone and email while meeting quality targets.
Suggested a shared template for common address changes that the team leader rolled out to 14 colleagues.
Logged recurring system errors in a tracker that IT used to prioritise two fixes.

education.details: Covered process modelling, requirements engineering, stakeholder analysis and Agile delivery.

education.degree: GCSEs: 9 subjects at grades 9–5, including English and Maths
